purpose: Implement the shared durable execute-once operation journal: exact approved operation identity, route-bound outbound execution claim, append-only terminal receipt/evidence history, explicit UNKNOWN with no retry, and evidence-backed reconciliation without provider or DAW execution.

lineage.outcome: N0TE can durably identify one exact approved operation, issue at most one execution claim, preserve real receipts/evidence or UNKNOWN truth, and reconcile ambiguity later without retrying blindly.
lineage.capability: Execute-once operation journal with receipt, UNKNOWN and reconciliation semantics

n0te2_dependencies: CORE-01 Activity and durable local persistence
legacy_candidates: provider idempotency/receipt and Gate-style transaction semantics as behavioral evidence only
legacy_rejections: provider or DAW executor inside journal

completion_proof: exact duplicate preparation is idempotent while one key cannot bind a materially different operation
outbound preparation binds one exact transport route and rejects a missing route
claim requires the exact still-valid approval and, for outbound work, an ALLOW decision for the exact prepared route
wrong-route or DENY transport evidence cannot claim execution
execution may be claimed at most once and terminal/UNKNOWN operations cannot be claimed again
SUCCEEDED requires receipt, evidence and result fingerprint; FAILED and UNKNOWN require explicit evidence
UNKNOWN remains recorded history and may be reconciled exactly once to observed SUCCEEDED/FAILED with explicit evidence
reconciled success requires real receipt and result fingerprint; failed reconciliation does not invent a receipt
operation identity and lifecycle events are immutable/append-only and survive restart
operation lifecycle journals into canonical Activity chronology
tampered event ordering or invalid Song/version binding fails visibly on reopen
journal contains no provider, DAW, socket, sync, upload, publish or mutation executor
next_selection_rule: After CORE-04D evidence, reconcile and globally compare host multi-step transaction/compensation, provider contract/receipts, entitlement/freshness/credential trust and preserved CORE-02 Success Memory. Do not add a real executor merely because the journal can issue an execution claim.
